vintage: INE Censo anual de población (Ocupación y actividad), 1 January 2024

rule.text: A district appears when the city's employed residents in its CNAE divisions are at least 1.25 times the national share and number at least 1,000 people or 1% of the city's employed, or when one of its specialities reaches 3 times the national share with at least 5,000 people or 0.5% of the employed. Districts are ranked by how many people they employ above the national norm, up to 5 per city. A Harbor also needs a city hex on or next to water or on a mapped river. The city type is named after the strongest district, or after a speciality with a quotient of at least 6 and at least 3% of the city's employed when there is one; “Capital city” is Madrid's Government plaza. Employment is from INE's Annual Population Census (employed residents, counted where they live, by two-digit CNAE-2009 division) for the 151 cities INE publishes at that detail.
rule.county_note: Municipalities have no districts of their own: the census publishes two-digit divisions for the main cities only.

method.note: The census counts employed residents where they live, by the CNAE-2009 division of their job; it records no wages, so there is no average pay. Two-digit divisions are coarser than the US NAICS codes.

0.description: Science and technology: research and development, programming and computer services, information services.

1.name: Commercial hub
1.description: Finance and insurance: banks, insurers and the services around them.

3.name: Harbor
3.description: Sea and inland water transport (port services are part of the broader warehousing division and cannot be split off).
3.caveat: Only for cities with a hex on or next to water or on a mapped river.

4.name: Theater square
4.description: Culture and media: performing and creative arts, film, video and music, radio and television.

5.name: Entertainment complex
5.description: Leisure: sport, recreation and gambling, plus hotels and other accommodation.

6.name: Aerodrome
6.description: Air transport (aircraft building shares a division with ships and railway stock and cannot be split off).

7.name: Government plaza
7.description: Public administration, defence and compulsory social security (a single division: defence cannot be split off).

8.name: Aqueduct & dam
8.description: Utilities: electricity and gas, and water collection and supply.
